title: one lesson learned
description: One line of <home>/lessons/entries.jsonl, written by `lessons add --family --finding --evidence --rule`; docs/lessons/<family>.md is generated from it (Finding | Evidence | Rule | Recorded in). `origin` is where the finding came from (`lessons add --source civitai` sets origin civitai); `source` is who recorded it.

schema.description: the format and its version; always the first key

v.description: the line format's version: the number at the end of `schema`, so a reader can branch without parsing the string

recorded_in.description: the runbook or doc row the lesson also went into

by.description: the command that wrote the line, for example `kiln images label` (optional)

family_id.description: a model family id: the stem of families/<id>.yaml

ts.description: ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00; easel always writes the T and the UTC offset.

who.description: where the line's content comes from: `operator` (the person), the second source (policy.second_source_name, default `assistant`), or a tool, for example `kiln:images import` or `easel:workflows validate`
